notes.title: Instarion Trailer And Update
notes.content:
We just finished a playtest (thank you all for participating!) and are excited to present an updated Steam page: new trailer, bunch of screenshots, and fresh details about the game! 

In the near future, I will be fully focusing on further development of the new version of the game (as in the video and screenshots), which I have been working on since last summer. I will share more details later.

notes.title: Instarion Playtest Update v.0.2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
We’re releasing Instarion Playtest Update v.0.2!
We’ve added and improved a lot of new systems and contents: ground and space combat, quests, looting, trading, mining, new transport, weapons, enemies and many other things (patch note).
You could also follow the development and track all the future updates in our roadmap and Discord.
